mapper.sql: id, slug, name, category, subtype, description, address, ST_Y(location::geometry) AS latitude, ST_X(location::geometry) AS longitude, opening_hours, phone, website, image_url, source, source_url, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT slug FROM place WHERE slug = #{base} OR starts_with(slug, #{base} || '-')

INSERT INTO place (slug, name, category, subtype, description, address, location, opening_hours, phone, website, image_url, source, source_url, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{slug}, #{place.name}, #{place.category}, #{place.subtype}, #{place.description}, #{place.address}, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{place.longitude}, #{place.latitude}), 4326)::geography, #{place.openingHours}, #{place.phone}, #{place.website}, #{place.imageUrl}, #{place.source}, #{place.sourceUrl}, #{place.status}, #{now}, #{now}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE place SET name = #{place.name}, category = #{place.category}, subtype = #{place.subtype}, description = #{place.description}, address = #{place.address}, location = ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{place.longitude}, #{place.latitude}), 4326)::geography, opening_hours = #{place.openingHours}, phone = #{place.phone}, website = #{place.website}, image_url = #{place.imageUrl}, source = #{place.source}, source_url = #{place.sourceUrl}, status = #{place.status}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
